events.description: Lal Masjid (Red Mosque) conflict erupts; al-Qa`ida renews calls for jihad in Pakistan.
Abu Yahya al-Libi statement collapsing near/far enemy distinction.
Bin Ladin posts 'Remove the Apostate' on al-Buraq website.
Double suicide attack on Musharraf, reportedly planned by al-Qa`ida and executed by Jaysh-i-Muhammad.
Marriott Hotel bombing in Islamabad, claimed by Fidayin-i-Islam, with al-Qa`ida hallmarks.
Terrorist cell plotting against Zardari disrupted in Karachi.
Conflict between Nazir/Gul Bahadur and Baitullah Mehsud's TTP lasts until mid-2008.
al-Sahab 56-minute interview with Mullah Nazir.
Abu Yahya al-Libi releases 'Sharpening the Blades of Battle' via al-Fajr.
Lal Masjid (Red Mosque) conflict erupts; al-Qa`ida uses it to renew calls for jihad against Pakistan.
Abu Yahya al-Libi statement nullifying near/far enemy distinctions.
Two assassination attempts on Musharraf; one allegedly ordered by Abu Faraj al-Libi.
Double suicide attack on Musharraf planned by al-Qa`ida, executed by Jaysh-i-Muhammad.
Marriott Hotel bombing in Islamabad, unclaimed but with al-Qa`ida hallmarks.
A terrorist cell planning to target Zardari and provincial chief ministers was disrupted in Karachi.
Start of violent conflict between Nazir/Gul Bahadur and Baitullah Mehsud's TTP, lasting to mid-2008.
Formation of Shura Ittihad-i-Mujahidin under Baitullah Mehsud with Gul Bahadur as deputy, fostered by Mullah Omar.
Al-Sahab releases 56-minute video interview with Mullah Nazir declaring the Taliban alliance merged.
Musharraf leaves office after sustained al-Qa`ida calls for his ouster.
Zawahiri attacks the Pakistani president and urges the army to topple him (al-Jazira).
Al-Sahab releases a Zawahiri message urging Pakistani soldiers to disobey orders.
Usama bin Ladin's 'Remove the Apostate' is posted on the al-Buraq Islamic Network website.
Abu Yahya al-Libi's 'No Room for International Legitimacy' statement.
Attack on Musharraf, followed by arrests (BBC, December 27, 2003); five later received capital punishment (August 2005).
Five people sentenced to capital punishment for the attack on Musharraf (Pakistan Times report date).
Jihadis strike the Pakistani Army and ISI again (analysis of November 25, 2007).
Seven al-Qa`ida commanders reportedly enter Pakistan, reportedly targeting Pakistani leaders including Gilani and Kayani.
Fidayin-i-Islam claims responsibility for an attack (Dawn, September 23, 2008).
Asia Times Online reports a plot to divide the Taliban was foiled.
New York Times reports that Afghan and Pakistan Taliban close ranks.
Interview with Mullah Nazir Ahmed, amir of mujahideen in South Waziristan, posted on Jamia Hafsa Forum.
Abu Yahya al-Libi's 'Sharpening the Blades of Battle Against the Government and Army of Pakistan' released by al-Fajr Media Center.

key_claims: Al-Qa`ida's Pakistan strategy has shifted toward promoting confrontation with the Pakistani state while playing a secondary operational role.
Al-Qa`ida acts through three roles: religious justification, force multiplier, and mediator/coalition builder.
The Lal Masjid conflict of July 2007 was the turning point for al-Qa`ida's calls for jihad in Pakistan.
Al-Qa`ida defers leadership to local militants to protect its safe haven in FATA.
Al-Qa`ida certified the reconciliation between Nazir/Gul Bahadur and Baitullah Mehsud via the al-Sahab interview.
Abu Yahya al-Libi conflated near and far enemies, treating the US, Pakistan and Afghanistan as a single enemy.
